description: This Java class defines a credential type for storing RFC 2253 formatted subject DNs of client certificates, including a list of secrets and methods for managing these secrets.

classes.name: X509CertificateCredential
classes.description: A credential class for managing X.509 certificate secrets, extending CommonCredential, with support for JSON serialization.

methods.name: getSecrets
methods.description: Returns the list of X509CertificateSecret objects associated with this credential.

methods.name: setSecrets
methods.description: Sets the list of secrets, throws IllegalArgumentException if the list is empty.
